dataRequests.notice: Data subject access dossier (LGPD art. 18, II). Every request, allowed or denied, is written to the immutable trail — without the phone or e-mail given.
dataRequests.notResolved: No identity record found ({{status}}) — sessions are still searched by the phone/e-mail given.

erasure.title: Erase this person's data (LGPD art. 18, VI)
erasure.explain: Anonymizes content and identifiers in every store the access report covers; durations, outcomes and scores stay, with no link to the person. Stores listed as not covered are not reached. Preview first — nothing changes until you confirm.
erasure.confirmLabel: I confirm the erasure of this person's data. This cannot be undone.
erasure.vetoKept: This person has a do-not-contact veto: it is kept (only the veto and the salted anchor hashes), so they are not contacted again.
erasure.partial: Erasure INCOMPLETE — these stores failed: {{stores}}. Repeat the request once they are back.
erasure.attachmentsNote: Attachments and recordings stop being served now; the files are removed by the hourly expiry cycle after its grace period.
